purpose: Python development with uv, pip, venv, native compilation and PostgreSQL clients.
limitations: Install project dependencies from uv.lock, requirements files, or the project manifest.
Compatibility with a particular project must include its dependencies, not only requires-python.

changes: Accept a mounted multi-certificate PEM CA bundle; validate all certificates before replacing managed trust and retain single-certificate and root/user behavior.
3.14-trixie.migration: Compatible CA setup fix. Continue using the normal root entrypoint and mount a certificate or PEM bundle read-only through LIBRARY_CA_FILE (CA_CERTIFICATE in wrappers). Existing explicit Composer/Node CA settings and PUID/PGID behavior remain supported. Published pins stay unchanged until deliberately upgraded to a verified release.
